tips.text: Play solo or with friends and recruit crew through Command; public Railjack squads leave together, often before minute 20.
Stay for 40 to 60 minute runs instead of restarting every 20 minutes; the Railjack intro and boarding is the real drag.
Do the farm while you grind Railjack intrinsics, Endo or Steel Essence on the same node, so the blueprint costs you nothing extra.
Bring a Necramech; they are allowed inside Corpus Proxima ships, make the Survival trivial, and it is a good place to level one.
Kill the Aurax Atloc Raknoids fast, since they carry the part blueprints.
Join a squad whose host already has Lu-yan unlocked to skip the gate.
Look under blueprints/misc in the Foundry for the Barrel, Receiver and Stock; they are not in the weapon tab.
Expect a bad-luck streak of five or more hours on any node; the 1-in-6 roll is the whole grind.
Almost nobody says the gun justifies the time; treat it as Mastery fodder.
